description: Search messages on every list (or the lists in inbox) by semantic similarity using vector embeddings; each result names its inbox. Returns messages most similar in meaning to the query text. Requires embeddings to be generated first (see embedding_status). Each result carries an 'excerpt': the author's own words, quoted text and signatures removed.

inbox.description: Lists to search: omit (or "all") for every list, the default; one name such as pgsql-bugs; or several, comma-separated ("pgsql-hackers,pgsql-bugs"). Names from list_inboxes. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

query.description: Natural language query to search for semantically similar messages

name: semantic_search
